task: 修复 Codex 独立探针发现的 2 个缺陷：世界备份归属过滤与跨世界恢复（A23）
discoveredBy: Codex independent acceptance (docs/market-acceptance/20261003-W1-W3): independent-probes.trx showed 15 probes with 13 passed / 2 failed, and 08-failures-repeat.log reproduced both failures. MY OWN TESTS DID NOT CATCH EITHER DEFECT.
defects: GET /saves/{world}/backups ignored folderName and returned every backup of the instance (requesting worldB returned worldAs backup)
POST /saves/{world}/backups/{name}/restore did not check ownership: restoring worldAs backup into worldB returned 200 and wrote saves\\worldA (1) - a DATA SAFETY issue
fix: List filters by BackupFileInfo.GroupName == requested world (case-insensitive). Restore rejects with a readable error when GroupName does not match. Backups whose ownership cannot be parsed (fallback group name) belong to no specific world and therefore appear in no world list - a deliberately conservative choice.
decisiveEvidence: I copied Codex own IndependentRouteProbes.cs into the test project, ran it VERBATIM (file SHA 06B36DFF7C1F7275ACDC33C9...), got 15 passed / 0 failed (was 13/15), then removed the file immediately - no trace left in the repo.
myTests: 3 permanent tests: list scoped to the requested world; cross-world restore rejected with a readable error and the whole tree byte-identical (including no worldA (1) left behind); same-world restore still works.
redBaseline: reverting BOTH fixes produced exactly 2 failures - the two new tests
selfFoundIssue: My first run failed on MY OWN assertion: I used Assert.Contains("属于", body) but JSON responses escape non-ASCII as \\uXXXX. Fixed by parsing the JSON first. This rule is already in my own notes and I violated it again - the test now carries a comment about it.
stillNotCovered: the OTHER Codex acceptance artifacts are not yet read line by line - notably implementer-manifest-audit.json, which audits MY manifests
other backup entry points (e.g. delete backup) were not audited for the same ownership issue
real GUI backup screens not verified
